ui.confidence_help: Confidence estimates document type, not text accuracy.
ui.handwriting_help: Highlights are hints, not a detector of every error. Handwriting accuracy has not been measured; compare every word with the photo.

ui.edit_help: Correct dates, amounts, IDs, and missing words. The original OCR above stays unchanged for comparison.
ui.confirmation: I checked this text against the photo, including dates, amounts, and IDs.

ui.privacy: We do not save notices on our server. Photos and results stay in browser memory until cleared or you leave. Only the language preference is stored on this device.
ui.intro: Upload one page. Check the reading before using the results.
ui.headline: Read a notice
ui.connection_error: Cannot reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
ui.offline: You are offline. Reconnect to continue.
ui.https_required: Installation on your phone needs HTTPS.

ui.read_error: We could not read this photo. Try a clearer photo.

ui.unknown_skipped: Extraction skipped: document type is unknown. Choose a type or ask for help.

ui.extract_timeout: Extraction took too long. Please try again.
ui.reader_reviews: Dates, amounts, and IDs to check
ui.agreement_help: Agreed means both readers returned the same value. It does not mean verified. Check every candidate against the photo.
ui.uncertain_reading: Uncertain reading. Check the photo and edit the text below.
ui.warning_review: Check these reader warnings against the photo.
ui.reader_quality_warning: Little text was readable. Retake a clear, well-lit photo of the whole page.
ui.reader_preprocessed_warning: The image was enhanced for reading. Check dates, amounts and IDs against the photo.
ui.classifier_uncertain: Document type is uncertain. Check the original or ask for help.
ui.reader_incomplete_warning: The reading may be incomplete. Retake a closer photo of one page.
ui.reader_failed_warning: One reader failed. Reader agreement is unavailable; check every value.
ui.amount_confirmation: I compared every printed amount with the original photo and corrected any wrong digits, or no amount is shown. Matching reader results can still be wrong.
ui.rate_limit_error: The demo is busy or has reached its request limit. Wait a minute and try again; the hourly limit may take longer to reset.
ui.service_unavailable_error: The AI service is unavailable or its usage quota has been reached. Please try later or contact the app owner. No result was guessed.
ui.story_origin: After a health emergency, Anushka Jain’s parents asked her to help read a parking ticket. Even as a native English speaker, she struggled to understand it and figure out what to do next.
ui.story_purpose: Growing up in Jersey City’s vibrant, diverse community, Anushka saw how confusing notices could create barriers for many families. That experience inspired her to create Notice Decoder, using machine learning to make notices easier to understand.
ui.welcome_body: Start with a photo. Check the text. Find the details you need.
ui.tutorial_1_body: Include the whole page, with the words in focus. You can also choose a photo from your phone.
ui.tutorial_2_body: Compare the text with your photo. Correct any mistakes, choose the notice type, and check every date and amount before continuing.
ui.tutorial_3_body: See the deadline, amount and next steps. Open a source to compare it with the notice. If something cannot be verified, we will flag it for you.
ui.tutorial_4_body: Choose English, Spanish or Tagalog, or listen with Read aloud when a matching voice is available. Translations are unreviewed; verify important details with the issuing office.
ui.state_body: Choose the state that issued the notice, even if you live somewhere else. We’ll use it to show relevant parking-ticket websites.
ui.state_coverage: Parking links currently cover selected authorities in CT, ME, MA, NH, NJ, NY, PA, RI and VT. You can read a notice from any state.
ui.parking_intro: Match the issuer on your ticket before opening a link. These are general resources, separate from the facts read from your notice.
ui.parking_choose_issuer: Choose the issuer shown on the ticket
ui.parking_other_issuer: Not listed / private or campus ticket
ui.parking_select: Choose the issuer above to see its official route. A state alone does not identify the right payment office.
ui.parking_unlisted: We have not checked a payment link for this issuer. Use the issuing office’s contact details on the original notice to ask where to pay or request a review. Private lots, campuses and airports may use their own systems.
ui.parking_unsupported: We have not researched parking links for this state yet. You can still read your notice. Contact the issuing office listed on the original for payment or review options.
ui.parking_match: Confirm that the office and ticket details match your original notice.
ui.parking_check_options: Before paying, check the official site for payment eligibility, court requirements and review or appeal options. Use the notice and issuing office to confirm the amount and deadline.
ui.parking_external: Opens a new tab. Ticket and payment details are entered on the official service, not in Notice Decoder. External sites need an internet connection.
ui.parking_directory: Find your city or town’s official website
ui.parking_disclaimer: Not legal advice. Verify with the issuing office.
ui.parking_route_nj: For a New Jersey municipal-court parking ticket, open NJMCdirect with your original ticket ready. If it requires a court appearance or cannot be found, contact the municipal court on the notice.
ui.parking_route_jersey: On Jersey City’s Municipal Court page, use Pay Traffic Ticket for NJMCdirect. The same page explains hearing requests and court contact options.
ui.parking_route_nyc: For a New York City ticket, use Pay for tickets to reach CityPay, or Dispute tickets to review the city’s dispute process. This page is for NYC, not all of New York State.
ui.parking_route_philadelphia: Use the Online section of Philadelphia’s parking-ticket page. It also lists other payment methods and a link to dispute a parking ticket.
ui.parking_route_hartford: Follow Visit Hartford Parking Authority on the city page. Hartford directs parking-ticket payments to that authority.
ui.parking_route_new_haven: Under City of New Haven parking citations, select Pay or Appeal Here. Use the parking-citation entry, not the school-bus or other payment entries.
ui.parking_route_boston: Use Pay ticket online on the Boston Parking Clerk page. Have your ticket or notice number ready; the page explains other lookup and payment options.
ui.parking_route_maine: Select the exact municipality in Maine’s partner portal before entering a ticket or plate number. Only participating municipalities are covered. If yours is absent, contact the issuer; do not choose another town.
ui.parking_route_nashua: Use the online parking-ticket payment link on Nashua’s page. Its FAQs also include how to appeal or contest a parking citation.
ui.parking_route_hanover: Use the Parking Portal link under Pay a Ticket or Appeal a Ticket on Hanover’s page. Have your ticket and license plate numbers ready.
ui.parking_route_providence: Use Pay Parking Fines on Providence’s page, not the separate red-light and speed-fine link. Have your ticket or notice number ready.
ui.parking_route_burlington: Use Pay or Appeal Tickets on Burlington’s Parking Services page. The page also lists the parking office’s contact details.
